note: Hand-kept map for the Build canvas. Service lines with ids from the live SOW tool (sow/index.html CATALOG) keep their names, hours and sources from there; researched lines come from canvas/research/*.json. 'lines' are on when the play starts, 'more' are optional. Each play lists its products, their places ([column, row] on the canvas grid) any optional lines it turns on from the start ('on') and any starting lines it turns off ('off'). The custom play, Create your own play, lists the products a partner can add and their places on its grid; the canvas packs the chosen ones together. Outside systems (step 27): products marked 'outside' are systems the client runs outside Adobe. A play lists the ones a partner can add ('outside') and their places ('opos'); none is on when the play starts. Step 45: 'ostart' listed the outside systems on the canvas when the play starts (the CDN in every Brand Visibility play) until Nov 18 2026 (below); 'recommend' tags systems Recommended, with each one's reason in its 'rec'. A line or connection's 'tier' is the package it needs. Step 96: a built play offers outside systems only; 'kept' lists Adobe products a saved canvas keeps but the play no longer offers (AEM Assets on the AEM play). Nov 18 2026 (Adam: "a play should always offer them if there's a product on its canvas that connects to them"): besides its own 'outside' list a play offers every outside system that connects to a product on its canvas, so 'opos' also places the ones a play offers that way from the start (ChatGPT, Claude and Microsoft Copilot beside Customer Journey Analytics and Coworker, ChatGPT and Claude beside Edge Delivery Services, and the CRM beside Adobe Commerce); once a product is added, the play takes Create your own play's grid, which places them all. Nov 18 2026 (Adam: "for every single play we have and every single play we're going to build, we should automatically put those outside systems in and then people can delete them if they want"): a canvas that opens with products on it starts with every outside system that connects to one of them, and a ready-made play also with every system on its own 'outside' list, each with its connection's starting services; Create your own play opened empty starts with none. 'ostart' is no longer kept here: canvas/build.py works it out for each ready-made play (catalog.json and the SOW steps' CanvasPresets), and the canvas works it out for a card that opens Your own play. 'agentic' supplies the named plays for the Revenue growth goals questions. Each area has a stable id, question, matching keywords and one-line summary; 'all' opens all three together with its own products; a card marked 'named' names the canvases it opens after the area ('Find new customers') or 'all.name', and they keep their own compact 'places' (each product and starting system) until a box they do not place is added. Nov 19 2026: 'rows' is the first page, top to bottom: each row's heading ('head') and either its plays in order ('plays', with the start cards placed 'before' or 'after' the play they name) or the GenStudio card ('card': 'family'). A start card for an AI assistant names it ('assistant'): its chips show the assistant first, and its canvas starts with that assistant only among the AI assistants, the other outside systems as the rule says; marked 'named', its canvas takes the card's name. A product's 'info' is a short note an i beside its name opens, on its canvas box and its chip in the GenStudio answer.
own_sites_note: Nov 19 2026: the AEM Sites rule. Adobe's AEM page for the assistants covers AEM as a Cloud Service, not Edge Delivery Services, so beside Edge Delivery Services these connections (and the line XT03) do not show and bring no outside system.

new_service_defaults.owned_outside_note: Nov 21 2026 (Adam: the client already owns Customer Journey Analytics or Adobe Commerce, so the play needs the Brand Visibility services and its connection services; then 'go'): on these two plays the outside systems of the owned product stay on the canvas from the start and their services start unticked, one click to add. A canvas saved before this keeps its ticks (its own saved flag, ownedOutsideDefaults).

areas.line: Reach new buyers in ad and media channels, and show up when they ask AI.

Brand Visibility shows where the brand appears in AI answers, while Customer Journey Analytics uses the site's referral and order data to show which AI-referred visits led to a first purchase. The team can ask Coworker to break down acquisition results by channel in its Customer Journey Analytics data view.

areas.label: Keep customers
areas.question: My client is losing customers
areas.line: Journeys that keep customers coming back, and answers when they ask.
areas.why: Journey Optimizer can remind customers before a renewal and stop the reminders when a renewal event arrives. Brand Concierge can answer common renewal questions on the site using content the client approves. With renewal events connected, Customer Journey Analytics can show where customers stopped in the journey and how many renewed. The team can ask Coworker to investigate a drop before changing the message or its timing.
areas.deliverable: Build a renewal reminder and test it with a customer who renews and one who lets the renewal lapse. Check the concierge's answers against the client's renewal policy and give the team a report showing renewal rates for the customers who entered the journey.

refine.chip: My client needs to identify customers at risk of leaving

areas.line: The right offer for each customer on the site, and journeys that cross-sell.
areas.why: Target can test a second-product offer on the site, and Journey Optimizer can follow up with eligible customers who have yet to buy. To serve a Journey Optimizer offer decision directly in a Target activity, the client needs the Experience Platform Web SDK and either Journey Optimizer Ultimate with Offer Decisioning or the Offer Decisioning add-on. With order data connected, Customer Journey Analytics can compare purchases and revenue across test groups, and the team can use Coworker to explore the results.
